1. Outside quotes: shellSegments consumes `\`+next as escaped pair (both chars into cur), so `\<LF>` stays in the segment; tokenize's strip removes it → matches real shell continuation. ✓
2. Inside single quotes: LF not a separator in shellSegments; `\<LF>` stays in segment; tokenize strips it → argv content differs from real shell (real keeps both chars), but boundaries unchanged → decision-safe (fail-closed direction only).
3. Inside double quotes: same as #2 — content-only change.

So no functional issue for the gate's decisions.
